course.title: Digital Logic Design
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Design a micro-programmed control unit for a system that is able to display 0 to 9 through (12) seven segment display. The control unit takes two inputs $q _ { o d d }$ and $q _ { e \nu e n }$ and functions of the system for the inputs are below.

content.value_html:
qoddgevenAction
00Stay in the initial state; display nothing.
01Display even numbers only and back to initial state.
10Display odd numbers only and back to initial state.
11Display all the numbers and back to initial state.
